description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv4, which provides functionality to validate IPv4 addresses using regex matching within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv4
classes.description: A class that validates IPv4 addresses according to a regex pattern, designed to be reusable for IPv6 validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given IPv4 address string against the regex pattern; returns the address if valid, otherwise false.

methods.name: _loadRegex
methods.description: Lazy loads the IPv4 regex pattern into the class property to avoid caching issues.
